rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for something that is annoying or irritating.

example.english: You are so annoying that I can't get anything done.
example.traditional: 你咁煩，搞到我做唔到嘢。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 faan4 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 zou6 m4 dou2 je5

rows.note: Use this when the annoying thing is especially troublesome, inconvenient, or creates extra work.

example.english: This procedure is annoying because I have to fill out ten forms.
example.traditional: 呢個手續好麻煩，要填成十張表。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sau2 zuk6 hou2 maa4 faan4 jiu3 tin4 sing4 sap6 zoeng1 biu2

rows.note: Use this when the person or thing is annoying in an obnoxious or strongly dislikeable way.

example.english: They are annoying, always telling lies in front of people.
example.traditional: 佢成日喺人哋面前講大話，真係討厭。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 gong2 daai6 waa6 zan1 hai6 tou2 jim3

rows.note: Use this colloquial slang for someone or something especially irritating and hard to tolerate.

example.english: You are being annoying again, so stop singing here.
example.traditional: 你又煩膠喇，唔好再喺度唱啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 jau6 faan4 gaau1 laa3 m4 hou2 zoi3 hai2 dou6 coeng3 laa1
